description: This source file defines data models and provider logic for managing a shopping cart in a Flutter application, including CartItem class and CartProvider class with methods to add, remove, update, and clear cart items, and computes subtotal and total prices.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item in the cart, including item details, portion, spice level, add-ons, quantity, and computed prices.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: Manages the list of CartItems, provides methods to modify the cart, and computes subtotal and total prices.

methods.name: CartItem.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of CartItem with optional modifications.

methods.name: CartProvider.add
methods.description: Adds a new item with specified customizations to the cart.

methods.name: CartProvider.removeAt
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart at a specified index.

methods.name: CartProvider.updateAt
methods.description: Updates an existing cart item at a specified index.

methods.name: CartProvider.clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
